title: skills, docs(adr): objectstack-ui § App Navigation, the ADR-0019 status line and the ADR-0130 fact row still say defineStack judges only a type: 'app' package, now that #32586 holds a module package to one app
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgU7jN46DmQ6XFvz28s

Filing gate: ③ a follow-up the landing PR #32792 (for #32586) owes. The `Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` line of the #32586 PR (a `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` change owes the skills follow-up; product PRs never edit `skills/**`). Serial note 6821116381 on #32586 asked for it.

Reader: the `domain:skills` lane, once the #32586 PR is merged.

## 维护者速读

#32586 让 `defineStack` 也拒绝定义了两个以上应用的模块包（`type: 'module'`）。技能文档 objectstack-ui 的「App Navigation」一段只说它拒绝应用包（`type: 'app'`）里的第二个应用，读者会以为模块包可以放多个。这张卡把那句话扩到套件里的每个包。

## Business reason

`skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` § App Navigation (on `main` at the #32586 PR's merge commit) reads: "`defineStack` refuses a second in a `type: 'app'` package. A suite (an app package plus its modules) may surface more apps: a `type: 'module'` package may carry its own app, ...". Once #32586 lands, `defineStack` refuses a second app in a `type: 'module'` package as well, with `STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION` (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts#validateSingleApp`, package types `SINGLE_APP_PACKAGE_TYPES`). The sentence is not false, but an agent reading it can conclude that a module package may carry several apps, write one, and meet the refusal at `os validate` / `os build`. That is a metadata-authoring trap the skill should close.

## Work

1. In § App Navigation, say that `defineStack` refuses a second app in an app package and in a module package alike: at most one app per package of the suite (ADR-0019 (app-as-consumer-unit) D3 as amended). The remedy is the refusal's own: one app per package, each further app in a `type: 'module'` package of its own with the objects it shows.
2. Check the `objectstack-ui` eval `views-apps-actions-pages.json` (the "second app for the support team" prompt): its expected output already says a support product with objects of its own carries its app in its own module package; confirm it still grades the rule and needs no edit.
3. Pay for any added line with a removal, per the skills line ratchet.

## Also in this card: two governed records the landing makes stale

Named by the contract review of #32792 (comment 6833950860, ③); governed text, so it rides this skills-lane card, Tier H:

- `docs/adr/0019-*.md` status line ("Pending: the `defineStack` check that holds a module package to at most one app") and its "Enforced today, and not yet" paragraph: after #32792 merges, the check is enforced; record it with the merge commit.
- `docs/adr/0130-*.md` fact row (around line 154) "`validateSingleApp` constrains only `type: 'app'`": a dated reading that becomes false; amend or annotate it with the merge commit.
- Serial: #32664 (open, `domain:skills`) edits ADR-0130 D2 too; the claiming seat folds the two or serialises them.

## Out of scope (note only)

- `content/docs/ui/audience-based-interfaces.mdx` line 22 says the same thing for `type: 'app'` only ("A package of `type: 'app'` exposes exactly one App"). It is not a `skills/**` file; the lane may widen it in the same PR as a docs touch or leave it, it stays true.
- `docs/design/marketplace-publishing.md` (around line 430) says `defineStack` enforces at most one app per `type: app` package. Design record, not shipped.

## Acceptance

§ App Navigation states the rule for both package types, cites ADR-0019 D3 as amended, and the eval still grades it. `check:skill-docs` and `check:skill-refs` green.

## Dedupe

`"validateSingleApp" is:issue` → 8 (none open besides #32586); `App Navigation module package is:issue label:domain:skills` → 8, of which #32664 is the only open card and covers the D3 fold restatements, not this sentence.

Blocked-by: #32586
